symbols.read: Price has reclaimed the 722.40 lower pivot (now 724.80), breaking the level that previously capped the downside and shifting the 1H trend to up — the prior bearish call is now invalidated on structure, not just tagged. The overhead bear FVGs that capped bounces are gone; instead two bull FVGs at 708.95–713.24 and 713.46–719.01 sit below as support, and the combined bias has moved from SELL to HOLD. Bias is now neutral-to-bullish while price holds above 722.40, with the 686.36 target stale and 737.02 no longer a meaningful upside invalidation given the pivot reclaim. The BULLISH regime tag that previously conflicted with structure now aligns with the 1H flip, so the tighter-risk caveat is dropped; a loss of 722.40 back into the bull FVG stack would revive the bearish case.

The bearish setup is invalidated: price at 82,407.96 has reclaimed the 81,033.66 lower pivot and closed above the 81,563.68–81,920.00 FVG cap that previously defined the neutral-restoring level, so the prior bearish read no longer holds. The 4H direction remains bearish but the combined read has flipped from SELL to HOLD, with the 1H trend up and the last 1H candle closing at 82,116.00, confirming the short-term reversal. Bias is now neutral-to-bullish, with 84,352.00 as the level that flips structure outright bullish and 81,033.66 as the invalidation that would revive the bearish case toward 77,715.32. The two open bull FVGs at 80,998.01–81,218.23 and 81,246.02–81,700.00 sit below as support should price retrace.

Price has reclaimed the 2,403.69 lower pivot and pushed to 2,416.42, breaking the bearish structure that held in the prior read and flipping the 1H trend up (2,395.64→2,410.31, +0.61%); the 4H stays bearish but the combined signal has shifted from SELL to HOLD, so the prior bearish bias is revised to neutral. The overhead bear FVG at 2,397.96–2,413.14 that capped price is now being absorbed rather than rejecting, and the open bull FVGs at 2,354.54–2,370.66 and 2,372.57–2,387.72 sit below as support should price retrace. The 2,227.50 downside target is now stale given the pivot reclaim and bullish regime tag, and the SELL setup remains invalidated. Bias is neutral-to-constructive above 2,403.69; a sustained break back below that pivot (and the bull FVG stack) would revive the bearish case toward 2,227.50, while holding above keeps the path open toward the 2,579.88 upper pivot.

Bias flips to neutral-to-bullish: price has rallied from 101.01 to 104.46, reclaiming ground above the 100.92 target and turning the 1H trend up, while the combined read has shifted from SELL to HOLD. The prior bearish lean is now fully invalidated — the 107.16 short remains unarmed and the slide that had closed to within 0.1% of target has reversed. Two bullish FVGs at 101.33–102.09 and 102.17–103.39 now sit below as support, replacing the bearish 103.05–103.93 cap that price has already cleared. Key levels: 107.16 lower pivot is the next upside test and the level that would re-arm the short setup; a loss of 103.39 (top of the upper bull FVG) would weaken the bounce, and a break below 101.33 would revive the bearish case.

Price has pushed up to 57.37 from 56.97, breaking above the 57.29 prior 1H level and shifting the 1H trend to up, while the 4H stays bearish — so the combined signal has softened from SELL to HOLD, a revision from the prior read's intact bearish call. The bearish FVG at 57.42–57.53 remains the nearest supply capping price, with a fresh bullish FVG at 57.05–57.23 now acting as nearest support below. Bias is neutral-to-bearish: the 58.41 short entry stays expired and untriggered, stop 58.58 and target 55.37 untouched, and a sustained reclaim of 58.41 remains the invalidation that would flip the read bullish toward 61.45.

Price has pushed up to 4,184.84 from the prior 4,165.42, confirming the neutral-to-long bias and keeping the bullish 4H and up 1H trend intact. The key change is a new bullish 1H FVG at 4,169.84–4,174.52, which now sits as immediate support beneath price and gives the long side a structural cushion it lacked before. The 4,141.44 lower pivot remains the invalidation line — a sustained break below flips the bias bearish and re-arms the 4,065.48 target — while a push through 4,217.40 confirms the long continuation. Bias stays neutral-to-long with weak conviction until 4,217.40 clears or 4,141.44 gives way.

Bias flips to neutral-to-hold with a bullish lean: price has reclaimed the 1.31 lower pivot that the previous read flagged as the invalidation trigger, so the 1.20 downside path is now negated and the 1.43 upper pivot comes back into play. The 1H has flipped to an up trend (1.30→1.31), though 4H remains bearish and the combined signal is HOLD, so this is a structural repair rather than a confirmed breakout. The open bull FVG at 1.2764–1.2965 now sits below as support, and holding above 1.31 keeps 1.43 in focus. Invalidation: a sustained move back below 1.31–1.2965 reopens the bearish 4H case and revives the 1.20 target.
